name: Kubernetes Cluster Security Assessment
description: K8s cluster RBAC, pod security, and network policy checklist

items.name: Privileged Pod and HostPID / HostNetwork Inspection
items.how: Check if containers run in privileged mode (securityContext.privileged=true) or share host namespaces (hostPID, hostNetwork, hostIPC).
cases: Run kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.spec.containers[].securityContext.privileged==true)'
Verify Pod Security Admission (PSA) mode is set to 'restricted' or 'baseline'
items.expected: No unprivileged workloads run with securityContext.privileged: true. Host namespaces are disabled.
items.recommendation: Enforce Kubernetes Pod Security Admission with 'restricted' level. Disallow privileged containers and root users.
